description:
RESTATED 2026-09-03 after research (proto198.diff) and a cold review
(approve-with-fixes). Base accb5cfbe.

THE DEFECT (measured): is_subtype(mint_brand(int, "Meters"), int) = false,
is_subtype(int, Meters) = true, same for utf8/binary, display "int | Meters"
-- contradicting set-theoretic-types.md:219-240 (`utf8 <: binary`: a brand is
a nominal REFINEMENT of its inner). Cause: an unbranded Descr carries brands
= none() and the slot is compared as a set, so ∅ ⊆ {Meters} reads int ⊆
Meters. Live at HEAD through the only brand with traffic (compiler-known
utf8, resolve.rs:119, src/modules/runtime_library/utf8.fz): M.echo(binary)
called with a utf8 value -> spec/violation; Utf8.to_bytes(utf8) called with
a bare binary -> accepted.

THE ENCODING: brands is a conjunctive REFINEMENT FACTOR over all kind axes --
a Descr denotes one rectangle S x B, B over brand-names ∪ {unbranded},
`unbranded` an element every cofinite FiniteSet<String> contains and no
finite one names (finite_set.rs unchanged). unbranded int = brands any();
mint_brand = brands {name}; Descr::none() keeps brands none() (the union
identity: accumulators and ⊥ results stay on it -- 22 sites classified);
NEW Descr::unbranded() = none() with brands any() is every VALUE
constructor's base (13 constructors + 9 builder sites re-based; a builder
left on none() silently becomes ⊥ -- canon.rs saturate/absorb saturated
every axis to top during bring-up). intersect pointwise (Meters ∧ Feet = ∅:
ONE BRAND PER VALUE, stated as a LANGUAGE rule -- `Positive and Even` is
never, silently; no intersection TypeExpr exists); is_empty = brands.is_none()
|| every kind axis empty; union pointwise hull (see residue); negation two
rectangles, exact when the slot is ⊤; diff factor-wise and EXACT on
rectangles (the review proved the fourth branch exact); is_subtype unchanged
(diff empty) so the law falls out at every nested position; erase_nominal =
brands any() (cofinite branch DELETED); display/canon render a refinement
(utf8(binary), not(Meters)(int)); ⊥ now has several interned identities --
`looks_empty()` is the only bottom test (arrow_match.rs:277 corrected;
canon collapses every bottom to fp[none] none, pinned).

FOLDED FROM THE REVIEW: (1) the residue's reach: ANY union whose operands
disagree on both factors releases the slot -- `utf8 | nil` admits a bare
binary (fz-kdt.203 owns the cure: the slot on each DNF clause); the doc sentence
corrected and the residue pin extended to the single-brand case as a
labelled known-wrong pin (HEAD accepts it too). (2) Descr::kinds_overlap
(descr.rs:275) reads the slot as a kind and degenerates to true -- zero
callers: DELETED. (3) the "Which predicate, where" line `x is utf8
distinguishes a branded value` is false (the runtime predicate never reads
the slot): corrected; charlists.md:19 "brand axis" corrected; type-naming.md
/ type-world.md keep one vocabulary ("a slot, not a kind"). (4)
brand_refinement double-wraps a cofinite multi-name slot and is duplicated
in format.rs:40 and canon.rs:683: one function, one wrapping. RIP-OUT in the
same commit: brand_of at three layers; Descr::neg, Types::complement,
SharedTypes::complement (neg returns any for a branded input -- a trap; the
three test users become difference(any, x); neg_structure stays diff's
private helper); kinds_overlap; erase_nominal's cofinite branch;
requires_any's brand disjunct; the union-style rendering. structure_eq stays
syntactic (exact by construction of mint_brand; a semantic version closes a
diff -> is_equiv -> is_subtype -> diff recursion the Memo cannot guard) --
renamed to say so.

MEASURED (base 8de517a28): 13 unit pins (10 red at HEAD); matrix 485/6/9 (six
new brand trials red) -> 491/0/9; lib 1626/0/5; corpus interp (stdout +
stderr) / run / canon / --emit=stats 0 movers; FIFO/LIFO unchanged (the two
movers 00277 + dead_closure exist at HEAD); X5 with 192 stacked -> Known BY
THE LATTICE (192 owns that pin's doc rewrite). New fixtures:
brand_refines_its_inner (.oracle.exs "hi"/"hi"/true/:matched -- Elixir owns
the golden because the brand is invisible to it, fz-bsx) and
brand_rejects_a_bare_inner (expect: diagnostic spec/violation).

OWNER QUESTIONS (recorded, not blocking the lattice): a minting form for
branded values -- a declared return does not mint one (`@spec mint(binary)
:: utf8; fn mint(b), do: b`: the caller sees binary; only an extern
returning any mints today) and it must not route through `|`; and the
@spec return side is never checked (fz-kdt.201).

BLOCKS fz-kdt.192 (192 lands strictly after; on HEAD's lattice it would
harden the inverted answer). RED-FIRST: cargo test --lib brand_lattice_law
10/13 -> 13/13; the six brand matrix trials; 485/6/9 -> 491/0/9; the corpus
quartet 0 movers.

comments.text: RESEARCH DONE, PROTOTYPED (2026-09-03, proto198.diff, being cold-reviewed). THE ENCODING: brands is a conjunctive REFINEMENT FACTOR over all kind axes -- a Descr denotes S x B with `unbranded` an element every cofinite FiniteSet contains and no finite one names (finite_set.rs unchanged); unbranded int = brands any(), mint_brand = brands {Meters}; Descr::none() keeps brands none() (the union identity), NEW Descr::unbranded() is every value constructor's base (13 constructors re-based; six sites built from none() had silently become the empty type -- two in canon.rs saturate/absorb saturated every DNF axis to top); intersect pointwise (Meters ∧ Feet = ∅: ONE BRAND PER VALUE), diff factor-wise and exact for the three brand shapes, negation two rectangles (Descr::neg now test-only), erase_nominal = brands any() (cofinite branch deleted), display renders a refinement: utf8(binary), not(Meters)(int). Deleted: brand_of at three layers. MEASURED: 13 unit pins red at HEAD / green; lib 1626/0/5; matrix HEAD 485/6/9 (six new brand trials) -> 491/0/9; corpus interp/run/canon 0 movers, executables 5297; the live defect: M.echo(binary) with a utf8 value -> spec/violation at HEAD, "hi" fixed; Utf8.to_bytes(utf8) with a bare binary -> accepted at HEAD, spec/violation fixed (two new three-door fixtures). RESIDUE: a union of brands over DIFFERENT inners loses the pairing (needs a union of rectangles; unreachable: no program has two brands). OWNER QUESTIONS: (1) is one brand per value the model? (2) `int` = "int, branded or not" -- a bare int is not writable in source. (3) THERE IS NO USER-LEVEL WAY TO MINT A BRANDED VALUE: `@type Meters :: refines integer` declares the type but every body producing one returns a bare int, which the argument gate then rejects at any Meters position; utf8 works only because an extern returns any and the return side is unchecked (fz-kdt.201). A minting form (Meters.new/1, an `as` cast, or `refines` publishing a constructor) is a prerequisite for user brands to be usable at all.

title: [BUG] The brand lattice is inverted (int <: Meters, Meters ⊄ int): brands become a refinement FACTOR over the kind axes so the documented law `utf8 <: binary` holds by construction
